items.raw_excerpt: The Chinese box office hit is drawing overseas visitors to the Chaoshan region, transforming filming locations into heritage tourism hotspots and raising questions about preservation and privacy.
items.summary_en: The Chinese box office hit is drawing overseas visitors to the Chaoshan region. Filming locations are being transformed into heritage tourism hotspots. The trend is raising questions about preservation and privacy in local villages.
items.summary_ko: 중국 흥행 히트작이 차오산 지역에 해외 관광객을 불러모으고 있다. 촬영지들이 문화유산 관광지로 탈바꿈하면서 보존과 프라이버시 문제도 함께 제기되고 있다.
items.title_en: Box office hit Dear You is fuelling heritage tours to China's Chaoshan. How are villages responding?
items.title_ko: 흥행 히트작 'Dear You'가 중국 차오산 지역 문화유산 관광을 활성화하고 있다. 마을들은 어떻게 반응하고 있을까?
items.title_original: Box office hit Dear You is fuelling heritage tours to China’s Chaoshan. How are villages responding?
